task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Using the left arm, move the yellow-blue rubikscube left of the rounded bar of dark soap.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架使用左臂，将黄蓝色魔方移动到圆形深色肥皂条的左侧。
